final_assessment: Change-size question settled at Sal's direction, by counting against the baseline specs. Only two requirements ask for a body's mirror note (orbit-conventions' Review mode decision framework and orbit-emit-composition's VERIFICATION-genre payload requirement); the others describe a copy held byte-equal, which stays true (D-tb-12, fact), so the earlier 'eight specs' was an overstatement. The resolution and the descriptions ledger entry were replaced with corrected wording (resolution-2026-11-17T20-16-12Z.json, ledger-2026-11-17T20-16-13Z.json); the ledger also drops a wrong claim that audit-drift's 'four categories' was stale, since its spec owns four. D-tb-13 (scope): one change, three capabilities (orbit-conventions, orbit-emit-composition, orbit-skill-generation), about seven requirements, delta-spec bytes well under the ceiling; tasks are counted at propose. D-tb-6 now counts thirteen mirror notes in the twelve bodies. One open question remains: how the removals are tested.
